_comment: Emission factors for EcoRoute Optimizer. Each entry carries value, unit, source, year, and boundary. Factors marked VERIFY must be confirmed before publication.

petrol.source: IPCC 2006 Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories, Vol. 2 Ch. 3, Table 3.2.2; consistent with BEE India fuel emission factors
petrol.notes: Direct combustion emissions only. Does not include upstream (well-to-tank) refining or transport emissions.

diesel.source: IPCC 2006 Guidelines for National Greenhouse Gas Inventories, Vol. 2 Ch. 3, Table 3.2.2; consistent with BEE India fuel emission factors
diesel.notes: Direct combustion emissions only. Does not include upstream (well-to-tank) refining or transport emissions.

india_grid_electricity.source: VERIFY: CEA CO2 Baseline Database for the Indian Power Sector — confirm version and year before publication. Provisional figure from CEA 2022-23 report.
india_grid_electricity.notes: National grid-average generation emission factor for India. Varies regionally and diurnally. NOT comparable to tailpipe figures without explicit accounting boundary disclosure.
